draftFindings.observation: Courtyard setting, labelled HP rows, larger distinct rival silhouettes.
Danger prompt now follows the live dash count.
Removed the 0.12 s link; a strike prompt always has a drawn shape.
Sidestep-only won everything; heavy attacks (3 HP, magenta, >=0.9 s) now require a dash; sidestep-only wins 0/40, a dashing policy 40/40 in both reaction bands.
No-charge heavy prompt now 'No dash: run if you can!'.

finalReview.evidence: 62/62 tests, 99.05% line coverage. ~70,000-position telegraph sweep with heavy attacks: 0 misses, 0 false hits. Invalid time inert; identical state at 30/60/120 Hz. Dash invulnerability exactly 0.3 s with a 0.2 s heavy dash window. Sidestep-only 0/40, dash-when-needed and full dash policies 40/40 in both reaction bands; Space spam loses on rival 1.
finalReview.limitations: Kade's slash can miss a body corner overlapping its edge by under 2 px (sampling limit, favours the player).

draftFindings.observation: 'bloom in 0s' countdown counted grown plants; now only plants still growing.
Description now states that weevils sense live roots and take another lane.
Casual play lost Twin Lanes; weevil detour penalty capped and lanes alternate, plus bare-lane chevrons and prompt.
Casual play lost Greenhouse Crossing; plot 3 now starts with 5 seeds and 5 s pest gaps.
Unused full blooms could tie up all seeds; blooms unbitten for 15 s are marked and the no-seed prompt names them.
A harvest prompt could outlive harvestability during its 0.6 s hold; it is now replaced immediately (0 bad frames in ~379,000).

finalReview.evidence: 44/44 tests in three consecutive runs; 100% line, 97.57% branch coverage. Prompt-following casual policy won 30/30 at 30/60/120 Hz with 0.4-0.6 s delay. No-seed prompt never named an unharvestable plant. State identical at 30/60/120 Hz over 60 scripts; 150-seed fuzz clean; getState/draw have no side effects.
finalReview.limitations: Policies that ignore the on-screen prompts (one-lane planting, harvesting only spent plants) still lose plot 2; ruled informative, not gating.

draftFindings.observation: Robot-to-robot resolution could teleport a robot past its partner or into a wall; robots now resolve sequentially with bounded snaps.
A reeled-in taut cable now prompts the pay-out key in every room.
Added the 0.4-0.6 s human band; widened corridors, thin live rings around plates and moved strips off natural routes.
'1 cell left' singular; loss text now says to keep the robots, not the insulated cable, off live strips.
Collinear float noise could hook the cable on a corner it no longer touched; wraps now need a noise floor and a truly blocked segment, with replay and fuzz regressions.

finalReview.evidence: 46/46 tests; 100% line, 97.13% branch coverage. Fuzz at 30/60/120 Hz in both modes: 0 teleports, 0 in-wall frames, cable never stretched or crossed a wall. Phantom-hook replay fixed. State identical across rates; invalid dt inert; terminal once and frozen. Ring pits reachable only by cable; pads reachable; markers >= 35 px from live strips.
finalReview.limitations: The reviewer's own slow-band policies were weak (mostly timeouts at pads) and did not reproduce the owner's 26-28/30; a 630,000-frame scan found one single-frame transient corner bend at 120 Hz. No full soft-lock search.
